method: Fix commits found by the same search (scripts in the 2026-11-25 record) in 117 repositories outside every dev-set repository; commits shared with the dev set dropped; picked by commit message alone, before any checker ran; all four checkers run by scripts/schematic_checker_benchmark.py on root sheets; each case judged by hand from the netlist change. A case counts when the fix changes the netlist and the bug is electrical; the rest are excluded with a reason.

tools.hs_review_dev_rules: a52834db (rules written from the 70 dev cases, run before this set was read)
tools.hs_review_current: 8d3315a7 (adds supply_rails_inverted, written after reading this set's Quango miss)

honesty: hs_review_dev_rules is the independent number: its rules were committed before this set was selected or read. hs_review_current adds one rule prompted by a miss here, so its extra catch is not independent. Three rules tried after reading this set (unfed VDD pins, undriven inputs, one-pin named nets) were dropped because they were wrong more often than right on the 110 known-good boards.

false_alarms.boards: 25 open reference boards and 85 held-out fixed boards
true_detail: NeoGeoAES-3.5 D5: LED anode on GND, cathode through R76 to VCC
Projet1AB LM393 U4: V+ on GND, V- on +3.3V_PI
false_detail: longboi BAV99: KiCad names its pins K, A, K; fixed by skipping parts that repeat A or K
meteo-station BME280 breakout compared with the bare chip; fixed by comparing only equal pin counts
false_alarms.after_fix: 3 findings, all on the two true defects

what_this_says: On projects its rules were not written from, HS caught 4 of 35 bugs (5 with one rule added after reading this set) against 9 for KiCad ERC and 9 for kicad-happy; ERC and kicad-happy together catch 12. HS adds bugs the other two miss (an IC with GND and VCC swapped; with the later rule, an op-amp on inverted rails) but misses the generic connection faults they check: dangling labels, undriven inputs, supply pins with no path to a rail, missing pull resistors on boot pins. All three together cover 14 of 35. 21 of the 35 are missed by every checker: connector pinouts, swapped signals with no pair name, part choice and design intent.
